criteria.text: The member has a diagnosis of moderately to severely active Crohn's disease or moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis. The treating provider must describe disease severity (for example, by symptom burden, a validated disease activity index, or endoscopic severity).
evidence_needed: Documented diagnosis of Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis
Treating-provider description of moderate to severe disease activity (symptom burden, validated disease activity index, or endoscopic severity)

criteria.text: Objective evidence of active disease dated within the 12 months before the request: either (a) an endoscopy, colonoscopy, or flexible sigmoidoscopy report describing active inflammation (such as ulceration, erosions, or friability), or (b) a fecal calprotectin result above the upper limit of the performing laboratory's reference range. An elevated C-reactive protein or erythrocyte sedimentation rate alone does not satisfy this criterion. Imaging alone does not satisfy this criterion.
evidence_needed: Endoscopy/colonoscopy/flexible sigmoidoscopy report describing active inflammation, dated within 12 months before the request, OR fecal calprotectin result above the lab's reference range upper limit, dated within 12 months before the request
Date of the qualifying report or result
Lab reference range for fecal calprotectin, if used

criteria.text: The medication is prescribed by, or in consultation with, a gastroenterologist.
evidence_needed: Prescriber specialty is gastroenterology, or documentation of consultation with a gastroenterologist

criteria.text: The member is 18 years of age or older. Requests for members under 18 fall under policy NHP-CCP-RX-0413 and are outside this policy.
evidence_needed: Member date of birth or age showing 18 years or older

criteria.text: Both conventional therapy and anti-TNF therapy history are documented. For each prior therapy, the record must name the drug, give approximate start and stop dates, and state why it was stopped. Prior therapy must be supported by pharmacy or medical claims, prescription records, or treating-provider chart notes; a treating-provider history without supporting records may be accepted on prescriber attestation. If claims or other records on file are inconsistent with the reported history, the request is referred for clinical review and is not approved on the reported history alone.
evidence_needed: Drug name, approximate start and stop dates, and reason for stopping for each prior therapy
Supporting pharmacy/medical claims, prescription records, or treating-provider chart notes, or prescriber attestation
Consistency between claims/records on file and reported history

sub_criteria.text: Inadequate response to, intolerance of, or contraindication to at least one conventional therapy. Conventional therapies are systemic corticosteroids (budesonide counts as a corticosteroid), azathioprine, 6-mercaptopurine, and methotrexate; for ulcerative colitis only, oral aminosalicylates (such as mesalamine) also count. Inadequate response to corticosteroids includes steroid dependence (relapse during taper or within 3 months of stopping) and steroid-refractory disease. Drug name, approximate start/stop dates, and reason for stopping must be documented and supported by claims, prescription records, chart notes, or prescriber attestation.
evidence_needed: Name of conventional therapy tried (systemic corticosteroid incl. budesonide, azathioprine, 6-mercaptopurine, methotrexate, or for UC an oral aminosalicylate)
Approximate start and stop dates
Reason stopped: inadequate response (incl. steroid dependence or steroid-refractory disease), intolerance, or contraindication
Supporting claims, prescription records, chart notes, or prescriber attestation

sub_criteria.text: Inadequate response to, intolerance of, or contraindication to at least one TNF blocker: adalimumab or infliximab, including any biosimilar of either. Primary non-response, secondary loss of response, and intolerance each qualify. A contraindication must be specifically documented (for example, demyelinating disease or moderate to severe heart failure). Drug name, approximate start/stop dates, and reason for stopping must be documented and supported by claims, prescription records, chart notes, or prescriber attestation.
evidence_needed: Name of TNF blocker tried (adalimumab, infliximab, or a biosimilar of either)
Approximate start and stop dates
Reason stopped: primary non-response, secondary loss of response, or intolerance; or a specifically documented contraindication
Supporting claims, prescription records, chart notes, or prescriber attestation

criteria.text: Negative tuberculosis screening test (interferon-gamma release assay or tuberculin skin test) dated within the 12 months before the request. An indeterminate IGRA is not a negative result. A test ordered but not resulted does not satisfy this criterion (per 2026-10 revision history). If the screening test is positive, the record must show active tuberculosis was excluded by chest imaging and that treatment for latent tuberculosis has been started.
evidence_needed: Resulted IGRA or tuberculin skin test dated within 12 months before the request
Negative result (indeterminate IGRA does not count)
If positive: chest imaging excluding active TB and documentation that latent TB treatment has started

criteria.text: Results of both hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and total hepatitis B core antibody (anti-HBc) are on file. No lookback limit applies. If either result is positive, the record must include a plan for monitoring or antiviral prophylaxis. Hepatitis B vaccination history, or a hepatitis B surface antibody (anti-HBs) result alone, does not satisfy this criterion. A test that has been ordered but not resulted does not satisfy this criterion.
evidence_needed: Resulted HBsAg test
Resulted total anti-HBc test
If either positive: documented monitoring or antiviral prophylaxis plan

criteria.text: Ustekinumab will not be used together with another biologic agent, a Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitor (such as tofacitinib or upadacitinib), or a sphingosine 1-phosphate (S1P) receptor modulator (such as ozanimod or etrasimod). If the member is switching from one of these agents, the record must show that the prior agent has been or will be stopped.
evidence_needed: Current medication list showing no concurrent biologic, JAK inhibitor, or S1P receptor modulator
If switching from such an agent: documentation that it has been or will be stopped

criteria.text: Requested dose follows FDA-approved adult labeling. Induction: a single IV dose by body weight — 260 mg for 55 kg or less; 390 mg for more than 55 kg up to 85 kg; 520 mg for more than 85 kg. A current body weight dated within 30 days of the request must be documented for the induction dose. Maintenance: 90 mg subcutaneously every 8 weeks, starting 8 weeks after the IV dose. Maintenance intervals shorter than every 8 weeks are not approved on initial authorization.
evidence_needed: Requested induction dose and route (single IV dose)
Body weight dated within 30 days of the request
Induction dose matching weight band (260/390/520 mg)
Requested maintenance dose of 90 mg SC every 8 weeks starting 8 weeks after IV dose

criteria.text: The request must name the specific ustekinumab product; a request for 'ustekinumab' without a product is incomplete. Preferred products are ustekinumab-aekn and ustekinumab-ttwe (IV and SC). All other ustekinumab products, including the reference (originator) product, are non-preferred and are covered only if the record documents either (a) an inadequate response to, or intolerance of, both preferred products (intolerance of only one preferred product does not satisfy this), or (b) a contraindication or documented hypersensitivity to an inactive ingredient present in both preferred products and absent from the requested product.
evidence_needed: Specific ustekinumab product named in the request

If non-preferred product: documented inadequate response to or intolerance of both ustekinumab-aekn and ustekinumab-ttwe, OR documented contraindication/hypersensitivity to an inactive ingredient present in both preferred products and absent from the requested product

gaps.clinician_query: Dr. Rivera, for PA-0003 (ustekinumab-aekn), policy criterion 3.5(b) on prior TNF blocker failure: the records about adalimumab disagree. Your 10/28/2026 GI note and the patient-reported intake medication history from 10/14/2025 list adalimumab from 01/2024 to 06/2025 with loss of response. The prior GI's outside records (dated 09/12/2025) say the patient was biologic-naive, declined adalimumab in 01/2024, and was 'still undecided' in 06/2025. Please review and document which history is accurate, along with any records that back it up.
gaps.would_satisfy: Policy 3.5(b) accepts documentation of a TNF blocker (adalimumab or infliximab, including biosimilars) with the drug name, approximate start and stop dates, and reason for stopping (primary non-response, secondary loss of response, intolerance, or a specifically documented contraindication). This must be supported by claims, prescription records, chart notes, or prescriber attestation. Because the records conflict, the policy refers the request for clinical review.
